```{r}
library(DBI)
con <- dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb())

dbExecute(con, "CREATE TABLE salamander AS SELECT * FROM
  read_csv_auto('data/salamander/salamander.csv')")
dbExecute(con, "CREATE TABLE watershed  AS SELECT * FROM
  read_csv_auto('data/watershed/watershed.csv')")
dbExecute(con, "CREATE TABLE weather    AS SELECT * FROM
  read_csv_auto('data/weather/weather.csv')")
dbExecute(con, "CREATE TABLE austin_daily AS SELECT * FROM
  read_csv_auto('data/weathergov/austin_daily.csv')")
dbExecute(con, "CREATE TABLE usgs AS SELECT * FROM
  read_csv_auto('data/usgs/usgs_08155500_temp.tsv', delim='\t', comment='#',
  skip=1)")


```

```{r}
dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM salamander LIMIT 5")
```
